recorded.outcome:q-left-not-logged: 15.3 places a request with bytes written and nothing in the host's log as lost between the logs and reverses it even then; the 15.6 row says reverse and fix the link.
recorded.prompt:q-where-answers-stop: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-where-answers-stop: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-where-answers-stop: 15.3's fourth place, 15.3.1's unpaired approval and the 15.6 row 'answer received late or unpaired' point to the pairing fields.
recorded.prompt:q-equal-totals: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-equal-totals: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-equal-totals: 15.4 shows equal totals hiding two opposite 30.00 differences, one leaving a merchant short and one charging a cardholder.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-booked: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-booked: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-booked: 15.4's 802 bullet: a partial approval booked at the requested amount, the terminal told approved, the merchant paid only the approved amount.

recorded.prompt:q-left-not-logged:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-left-not-logged:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-left-not-logged:b: The 15.6 table names the host only when its log shows the request received; nothing in it points to the link.
recorded.prompt:q-left-not-logged:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-left-not-logged:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-left-not-logged:c: 15.3 allows a new message only when the request never left and has the switch reverse at the timeout, before anyone reads the other log.
recorded.prompt:q-left-not-logged:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-left-not-logged:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-left-not-logged:d: 15.3 reverses a request that left, and 15.6 points to the link, not the host, when the host's log shows nothing.
recorded.prompt:q-where-answers-stop:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-where-answers-stop:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-where-answers-stop:b: 15.3 and 15.6 place an answer that reached you and matched nothing on your side, not in the host.
recorded.prompt:q-where-answers-stop:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-where-answers-stop:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-where-answers-stop:c: 15.3 says a host's log showing an answer sent says nothing about your side until your own log shows it arrived; 15.6 points that case to the link.
recorded.prompt:q-where-answers-stop:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-where-answers-stop:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-where-answers-stop:d: 15.6 names the host only for a request received with no answer; an answer logged as sent points past the host.
recorded.prompt:q-equal-totals:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-equal-totals:a: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-equal-totals:a: 15.4's 802 and 804 show a merchant underpaid and a cardholder charged although the totals agree.
recorded.prompt:q-equal-totals:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-equal-totals:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-equal-totals:b: 15.4: the totals hide both, and a day that balances can hold any number of such pairs.
recorded.prompt:q-equal-totals:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-equal-totals:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-equal-totals:d: 15.6 gives the cause of an amount only in the network's report as an approval after a timeout never reversed, or a lost reversal, not a double count.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-booked:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-booked:b: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-booked:b: 15.4: the merchant is paid the approved 50.00 of 80.00, so a partial approval is not paid out like a decline.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-booked:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-booked:c: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-booked:c: 15.4: the issuer charges the approved amount, since the switch's booking moves no money.
recorded.prompt:q-partial-booked:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-partial-booked:d: independent readers: one with the page (Q1, Q3), one with the question's text only (Q2)
recorded.outcome:q-partial-booked:d: 15.4: the card is charged the approved amount only, and the difference falls on the merchant.
